prompt:
Fix the schema of sections/contact-form-trim.liquid. Leave the markup above {% schema %} unchanged and edit only the schema JSON.

The current schema has several problems:
- Some strings were pasted with stray leading or trailing spaces. This affects the section name and some defaults.
- The markup reads section.settings.success_message, but that setting is missing.

Every string in the final schema must be trimmed. The final schema must be exactly this object, with keys and settings in this order:
- "name": "Contact form"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "contact-form-section"
- "settings", in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Contact us"
  2. type "textarea", id "intro", label "Introduction", default "We usually reply within one business day."
  3. type "checkbox", id "show_phone", label "Show phone field", default false
  4. type "text", id "submit_label", label "Submit button label", default "Send message"
  5. type "text", id "success_message", label "Success message", default "Thanks for contacting us!"
- "presets": [{"name": "Contact form"}]

No other keys are allowed. Change only sections/contact-form-trim.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
